title: Geographic Analysis of Cancer Patients' Residences at Delafontaine Hospital
official: Geographic Analysis of Cancer Patients' Residences at Delafontaine Hospital
summary: This study looks at where cancer patients treated at Delafontaine Hospital live and how far they have to travel for care. By mapping patients' home addresses (anonymized), the research will show how distance, transportation, and social factors affect access to cancer treatments and support services. The goal is to better understand inequalities in access to care and to improve patient support in the future.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Adult patients treated for cancer in the oncology department of Delafontaine Hospital since January 1, 2020.

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Patients whose cancer treatment in the oncology department was completed before 2020.
